outputs.explanation: Panel A shows calculated percentage overhead values per exposure-time condition as a diagrammatic bar breakdown, not an average of replicate measurements with variability to be shown as individual points.
Line plot of photobleaching decay curves over frames; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points would make them unreadable.
Scatter plot of ΔROS vs exposure time; scatter plots are exempt because the plotted points themselves are the individual data.
Line plots of individual cell migration tracks; each line already represents a single migrating cell, and line plots are exempt from requiring additional overlaid points.
Bar chart of mean±s.e.m. migration speed has individual cell data points (dots) overlaid on each bar.
Panel F is a set of micrographs (MitoTracker/Paxillin images), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G is a micrograph time-series, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel H is a micrograph time-series, not a plot of averaged data.
Line plot of normalized cell area (mean±s.e.m.) over time; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Line plot of normalized mitochondrial area (mean±s.e.m.) over time; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
